displayName.description: Display name of the sector segment as presented in tables.
displayName.$comment: Segments are sector-specific: 'Storage' is meaningful for Power and meaningless for Land Use. draft-07 cannot condition this enum on a sibling 'sector' value -- and the if/then form that could collapses the generated object type to an index signature (see validateScopes.ts) -- so membership is enforced by validateScopedEntries against SECTORS_BY_KEY in src/utils/timeseriesTaxonomy.ts. Only Power's segments are defined so far; 'No information' is legal under every sector, so a pathway in a sector whose segments nobody has written down yet can still record data availability.
